I built version 11, but I couldn't run the agreed proof. Both shell calls were denied by this session's permission layer (no approval surface), so there is no `node --check` output. Nothing has been rendered in a browser either.

## Files changed
All four are new, under `design/prototypes/lsatu-dashboard/new-versions/11-claude-studio/`:
- `index.html`: the page shell, same structure as version 10 plus a light colour-scheme meta tag.
- `style.css`: written from scratch.
- `app.js`: adapted from version 10, with Home and the sidebar rebuilt.
- `README.md` (dated 2026-10-25): the visual direction, a change table against 10, what I borrowed, what was kept, the synthetic-data limits, and what was not verified.

Nothing outside that folder was edited. Nothing was committed, staged, pushed or deployed.

## The design
- **Look:** a warm linen page with a faint paper grain, and solid paper cards with crisp edges and short shadows. There is no blur anywhere, including behind dialogs.
- **Continue card:** the main card is a deep navy, the largest thing on Home. It shows the actual next statement ("Some of the books are illustrated.") in serif, a row of 12 numbered statement cells, and a parchment-gold button reading "Continue at statement 6". The landscape image sits masked in the right half, never behind text.
- **Colour:** Logical Reasoning is ink blue and Reading Comprehension is claret (deep red). Claret also marks unread items and the active nav item; brass marks progress. No apricot or orange.
- **Home layout:** a serif coach note, a large 7:15 p.m. session time, and a numbered assignment list. The week shows as a day list beside it on wide screens and as seven columns at mid widths.
- **Type:** Newsreader for headings and reading text, Manrope at 15–16px for the interface, mono only for question references.
- **Motion:** page sections rise in a short sequence on arrival, the completed statement cells fill one after another, and the agenda slides when you pick a day. Reduced-motion turns all of it off.

## Kept from version 10
Every feature on the work order's list is kept: all routes and the teacher views, filters, the question finder (typed references included), review links to the exact question, coach reply and mark read, notes and drafts, the keyboard shortcut, and the dialog and focus behaviour. Saved data uses the key `lsatu-claude-studio-v1`.

## Two behaviour changes
Neither changes a requirement; both are listed for review.
1. **Escape guard:** if a dialog has unsaved text, the first Escape shows a notice instead of closing; a second Escape closes it.
2. **Unsaved text is kept:** closing the session-prep or resume dialog without saving keeps the text in memory, and reopening restores it with a note saying so. Nothing is written to storage until Save.

## What the host needs to do
- Copy version 10's `assets/` folder unchanged. The page uses only `manrope.ttf`, `newsreader.ttf`, `newsreader-italic.ttf`, `mono.ttf` and `paper-landscape.png`, so no extra assets are requested.
- Run `node --check design/prototypes/lsatu-dashboard/new-versions/11-claude-studio/app.js`. I re-read the template strings and handlers by hand instead, which is no substitute.
- Do the browser checks at 1440, 1048×858, 390 and 320. Contrast, overflow and keyboard behaviour are all unmeasured, and I'd look hardest at the quick-action buttons and the seven-column week at around 1000–1100px wide.

There is no signed-in capture of the live dashboard, so this does not claim to match or beat production.
